tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch9:9-11Suppose $g$ is a Riemannian metric on the cylinder $S^1 \times [0,1]$ such that both boundary curves are totally geodesic. Prove that the Gaussian curvature of $g$ either is identically zero or attains both positive and negative values. Give examples of both possibilities. \end{exercise}
